name: NVIDIA GB300 NVL72
model: GB300 NVL72 (DGX GB300 / OEM MGX builds)
description: 48U NVIDIA MGX (Oberon) rack: 18 x 1U compute trays (each 2 Grace CPUs + 4 B300 GPUs, 4 ConnectX-8 800G SuperNICs, 1 BlueField-3), 9 NVLink 5 switch trays forming one 72-GPU NVLink domain, 8 x 1U 33 kW power shelves (6 x 5.5 kW PSUs each, AC-fed 200-480 V) feeding a 50/54 V DC busbar, and 2 SN2201 management switches. Hybrid cooling: GPUs, CPUs, HBM, ConnectX-8 and NVLink switches on cold plates (about 90%), drives, OSFP optics, power shelves and ancillary gear on air (about 10%). Power shelves carry energy storage for power smoothing. Some OEMs (Lenovo, Gigabyte) also offer a 6-shelf non-redundant build.

nominal_power_w.note: Lenovo: 135 kW TDP. Supermicro lists operating power 132-140 kW; HPE QuickSpecs (as summarized by flopper.io, HPE page not reachable) give 132 kW nominal TDP; Gigabyte lists up to 140 kW. Range spans the OEM TDP figures.

peak_power_w.note: Lenovo: up to 155 kW peak depending on workload and EDP behavior. HPE (via flopper.io aggregator) gives the same ~155 kW EDPp and recommends provisioning busways for 192 kW.

power_shelves.note: NVIDIA DGX GB300: eight shelves per rack. Lenovo offers 6 (non-redundant) or 8 (redundant); Gigabyte lists 6.

shelf_rating_w.note: six 5.5 kW PSUs per shelf; 8 shelves = 264 kW installed for N+N-style redundancy

liquid_fraction.note: Lenovo: rack-level split about 90% to liquid and 10% to air; NVIDIA RA confirms hybrid liquid plus air cooling.

max_coolant_supply_c.note: Lenovo: allowable water inlet up to 45 C; compute/switch trays rated 2-50 C (ASHRAE W45). This is the TCS supply to the rack.

rack_pressure_drop_kpa.note: Lenovo Table 27: 2.3 psi at 25 C supply (59 L/min), 3.2 psi at 30 C, 4.9 psi at 35 C, 8.5 psi at 40 C, 18.4 psi at 45 C (177 L/min). Pressure drop depends on supply temperature because required flow rises steeply.

flow_lpm_per_kw.note: Lenovo required rack flow (59 L/min at 25 C supply to 177 L/min at 45 C) divided by liquid heat of 0.9 x 135 kW = 121.5 kW.

thermal.quick_disconnect: UQDB04 blind-mate QDs between trays and rear manifold (UQD04 bleed port); manifold-to-CDU 1-inch FD83 BSPP; 30 psi static at QD (Lenovo). Top- or bottom-feed manifold options.

depth_mm.note: Lenovo and Supermicro: 1,068 mm; Lenovo's rack expands to 1,200 mm with an extension frame.

height_mm.note: Lenovo 48U MGX rack 2,294 mm; Supermicro datasheet 2,236 mm. flopper.io lists 2,495 mm for HPE, likely an outer or shipping dimension, so it is not used.

weight_kg.note: No OEM rack weight found. Press/blog figures conflict: ModulEdge 1,580 kg populated; flopper.io summary of HPE ~3,300 lb (1,497 kg); Introl ~1.36 t (GB200-era figure). Lenovo component weights give a floor: rack 185 kg + 18 x 29 kg trays + 9 x 17 kg switch trays + 2 x 11.4 kg SN2201 = 883 kg before shelves, busbar, NVLink cartridges, manifolds and coolant.

feet.note: MGX rack has casters plus leveling feet (visible in NVIDIA MGX clearance drawing); four corner leveling feet assumed. No point-load figure published.

service_clearance_front_mm.note: NVIDIA's MGX rack front service clearance (33 in) from its DGX B300 data center best-practices guide; applied here because GB300 uses the same 48U MGX rack. 1U trays are 766-799 mm deep.

service_clearance_rear_mm.note: No GB300-specific rear clearance published; rear access is needed for manifold, busbar and NVLink cartridge service.

scale_out_ports.note: four ConnectX-8 800G ports per compute tray x 18 trays (compute fabric only). Each tray also has one BlueField-3 with 2 x 400G for storage/in-band, not counted here.

scale_up_bandwidth_tbps.note: 130 TB/s aggregate NVLink 5 (1.8 TB/s per GPU) = 1,040 Tb/s

switch_slots.note: compute rack; the two in-rack SN2201 switches are 1G management only

network.port_media: OSFP 800G on front of trays (ConnectX-8 SuperNIC); optics or DAC/ACC per reach

hbm_tb.note: 72 x 288 GB HBM3e = 20.7 TB (Supermicro rounds to 21 TB; NVIDIA page says up to 20 TB)

fp4_pflops.note: dense FP4; NVIDIA's headline 1,440 PFLOPS is with sparsity

fp8_pflops.note: NVIDIA lists 720 PFLOPS FP8/FP6 with sparsity; dense is half
